programme.desc: Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troublesReal people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern lifenFrom money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life

programme.title: Serial Swindlers
programme.desc: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: For years, allegations of war crimes have swirled around Australia’s special forces in Afghanistan Australian prosecutors have been investigating a small group of elite special forces who stand accused of committing and covering up the murder of civilians in Afghanistan With exclusive footage and testimony from a former special forces operative, this documentary reveals a shocking culture of murder and impunity

programme.title: Peace On The Tigris
programme.desc: The Tigris River, which was the site of the ancient civilization of Mesopotamia, still flows majestically through Baghdad, Iraq's capital In March2003, the area around this river underwent intense airstrikes by US and British forces The US armed forces gained control of Baghdad Journalist Watai Takeharu witnessed the moment when the bronze statue of then-president Saddam Hussein was pulled down The next day he saw many victims of the airstrikes at a city hospital There he met 31-year-old Ali Saqban, whose home had been destroyed in the bombing In his arms he was carrying his 5-year-old daughter Shahad, whose body was covered with blood

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕(國語)
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:饒恕就是釋放 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:李盛林牧師-出埃及記
programme.desc: 前無去路,後有追兵,憑信心過紅海。n雲柱火柱日夜引路,天降嗎哪為持生命。n流浪曠野四十年,以色列人用血、淚、性命寫成的感人見證!n今天,對你有甚麼啟示呢?n李盛林牧師與你深入探討《出埃及記》中的主要資訊,讓信徒掌握此書卷之意義,並如何落實應用於現今世代。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

高朋滿座#160粵
programme.desc: 朋拼命地督促婷準備會考，令她苦不堪堪言。朋繼續迫婷溫習，根認為朋過分擔心，更吹噓自己若應考，成績絕對名列前茅。最後眾人將婷及根反鎖在家中，並在花的嚴厲教導下，強迫二人進行「地獄式補習」。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 安葬了楊鐵心夫妻後，丘處機與江南六怪讓郭靖娶穆念慈，郭靖不肯，被追問出心上人就是黃蓉時，六怪逼郭靖發誓不再與黃蓉來往，黃蓉突然出現，並趁亂拉著郭靖離開。穆念慈收留了落魄的楊康，楊康被穆念慈的氣節折服。

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 下廚樂趣無窮，肥媽用豆腐、茄子砌出美味的「日式層層疊」。肥媽解釋大廚為何偏愛牛尾煲湯，並示範「砵酒燜牛尾」。肥媽為創意美食「芝心豬扒」加添新意；還有「紅菜頭腰果湯」，為「多肉少菜」的觀眾平衡身體營養。

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG AI 點只科技股粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 交感神經負責調節不需意識控制的生理功能，當人體長期處於高交感神經興奮狀態，會對心血管系統造成不良影響。心臟科醫生詳析相關資訊，並提醒恆常監察血壓及心率的重要性。模特兒出身的藝人蔣怡下廚了得，育有一對子女，她會到來暢談近況。當年女兒出世不久，她為何決定赴倫敦進修廚藝？為着家庭喜好，蔣怡繼而學煮中菜；現時還在學習繪畫、唱歌等。纖瘦的她亦分享保持身型之道。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「瑤柱蟹肉蟠龍節瓜」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵PG
programme.desc: 豬雜粥配豬潤腸粉，以江門早餐迎接新一天！五邑菜結合五地精髓，從山螃蜞、黃沙蜆、馬崗鵝、杜阮涼瓜等細嚐地道風味。舊廠房變身文創熱點，星級茶餐廳老闆古明華為家燕姐調製奶茶，奉上港式美食，份外親切！換上民初服飾後乘船遊赤坎古鎮，感受中西合璧的古樸風韻；眾人還認識復古電訊設備，體驗傳統陶藝、玉石花手藝。私房菜餐廳自設荷塘，巧製荷葉水鴨湯、蒸釀蓮藕夾、冰鎮鮮蓮子等時令荷香美饌。另一探城央綠廊夜市的熱鬧氛圍。

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG AI 點只科技股粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 東坡家事#21粵PG
programme.desc: 安石外遊時與老伯下棋後生病，李大夫發現其脈象奇異。皇上派少游和兩太醫往蠶村了解疫情；小妹找洪四相伴往蠶村。少游明白這病易傳染，隔離病人；小妹被女病人弄傷手指……李大夫目露凶光向眾人襲擊後吐白泡死去……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 前田同學衣服上的紐扣不見了，但遍尋不獲，藤木發現紐扣掉進了自己的手提袋，卻不敢說出來。小丸子擦走家中白板上自己的留言，卻不慎把媽媽的留言擦去部分，唯有循剩下的「大」字作出種種聯想。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 芭菲精靈留守零食廠考核小朋友，但簡單一個附帶「廠長話」的指令，竟揭露大家不懂得芭菲精靈是誰？某隊兩位成員同時齊心放下手，結果就此錯失了一卷健康零食秘笈！不過，該隊伍並無灰心和氣餒，在「魔法地壺」遊戲中成功收集四款食材，吐氣揚眉。運送雪糕球任務，四位小兵都穩穩陣陣，快速將雪糕球運送到終點。哪一方能取得最後一卷健康零食秘笈，視乎雪糕球總數來定斷。另外，「AI小學堂」會探討如何利用運算思維向AI提問。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 柚子公主又偷走出城堡外，柚子爺爺發覺之後慌忙尋找。另一方面，細菌人按紅精靈的要求，想把柚子公主抓回去。細菌人製造了科學怪機，因此科學怪機認定細菌人是爸爸，並且很想與他見面。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 目前香港長者北上就醫可使用醫療券，於大灣區指定服務點支付門診費用。另外，部分香港商業保險亦已開通跨境「保險直付」服務，讓患者在指定三甲醫院就診時免去墊付流程。內地公立醫院與私家診所價格和質素參差，加上醫療券、直付及內地醫保等多種支付方式並存，如何釐清各種方案的適用範圍與限制？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵
programme.desc: 山頂纜車站某的士司機涉嫌「揀客」拒載，遭警員檢控，繼而引發爭執。的士同業直言行內有不少害群之馬，呼籲警方加強執法。啟德新發展區有居民控訴，區內巴士站的配套設施存在落差。然而攝製隊調查後發現，「差別待遇」或是一場誤會。葵涌廣場有童黨集結，眾人大聲喧嘩、騎單車等行為，對商戶及顧客造成嚴重滋擾。據指童黨與商場內已結業小店的老闆娘關係密切，她有何回應？《愛．回家之三代同糖》首播，車婉婉、吳若希等齊聚觀劇。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#2粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰與萬里、唐芯同住，擾亂萬里的生活。萬里致電父親欲探知嘉冰回港的真正目的，卻無功而回。嘉冰則向弟弟曹嘉驄透露秘密，並表明打算留港長住。萬里追問嘉冰歸期，嘉驄謊稱她不久便會回去，萬里卻想令嘉冰知難而退。另一方面，唐芯欲查明嘉冰與萬里甚少往來、似有嫌隙的原因，卻不得要領。她告知嘉驄自己已獲批大學宿位，有望擺脫萬里的控制，並想到能順利入住宿舍的方法，而嘉冰正是關鍵人物。唐芯為此付出不少努力，詎料……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#7粵PG
programme.desc: 啟榮知道家謙暗助幸如而發脾氣，原來他患有情緒病。祖母葉卓苓君讚賞家謙，啟榮暗中不滿。幸如差點被車撞，家謙及時相救，幸如閃過之前遭車撞的零碎片段。浩恩對幸如未忘情；家謙得知浩恩是幸如初戀，與他暗地較勁。幸如得悉家謙知道自己做了預知夢，家謙坦言不信但願意幫忙。幸如得知雪文買了催情藥，欲借助家謙推雪文與繼威一把，不料雪文打算將藥用在幸如和浩恩身上。幸如及時發現雪文詭計，腦筋急轉反擊，卻意外掉到水中。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 主動脈負責將心臟泵出的血液供給全身各個維生器官，極為重要，一旦撕裂，每小時會增加約1%死亡率！有何高危因素？心胸外科教授指，此症還要視乎是升主動脈還是降主動脈出狀況，前者要急切施行開胸手術，期間需停止心臟，並以體外循環機輔助。高血壓是主動脈撕裂的風險因素之一，而高血壓人士或患有胸腔主動脈瘤，一部小小的手提超聲波即可初步探測？教授形容主動脈撕裂像計時炸彈，建議於爆炸前就「拆彈」，如何從生活習慣預防？

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#12粵普
programme.desc: 中菜廳被迫停業，紀封打算趁機整頓餐飲部，還得到董事會同意重新裝修中菜廳；但是翱翔搶走了裝修公司，紀封決定向嘉銘請教；記者拍攝菲菲的日常，豈料被冰燕搶走了鏡頭；馬科斯的代理跟紀封簽約，誤以為貞貞是蜜語…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵

再創世紀#20粵
programme.desc: 金水村非原居民代表袁康年不想賣地，定垚查得康年的秘密，康年答應不再帶頭鬧事。依寧給敬賢帶來天生的負面資料，敬賢為求真精神專訪天生。天生被詹兆齊出賣令競選商會主席失敗，懷恨在心。程凱為智能家居20連夜趕工，因睡過頭趕不及董事會，澤雨只好拿出尚未完善的10來彙報，程凱大發雷霆。天生游說海泉賣地，海泉竟破口大罵，天生忍無可忍直斥海泉無能，從未給予妻女幸福。海泉突然支持賣地，同時有雜誌揭破康年的秘密…

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 交感神經負責調節不需意識控制的生理功能，當人體長期處於高交感神經興奮狀態，會對心血管系統造成不良影響。心臟科醫生詳析相關資訊，並提醒恆常監察血壓及心率的重要性。模特兒出身的藝人蔣怡下廚了得，育有一對子女，她會到來暢談近況。當年女兒出世不久，她為何決定赴倫敦進修廚藝？為着家庭喜好，蔣怡繼而學煮中菜；現時還在學習繪畫、唱歌等。纖瘦的她亦分享保持身型之道。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「瑤柱蟹肉蟠龍節瓜」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵PG
programme.desc: 豬雜粥配豬潤腸粉，以江門早餐迎接新一天！五邑菜結合五地精髓，從山螃蜞、黃沙蜆、馬崗鵝、杜阮涼瓜等細嚐地道風味。舊廠房變身文創熱點，星級茶餐廳老闆古明華為家燕姐調製奶茶，奉上港式美食，份外親切！換上民初服飾後乘船遊赤坎古鎮，感受中西合璧的古樸風韻；眾人還認識復古電訊設備，體驗傳統陶藝、玉石花手藝。私房菜餐廳自設荷塘，巧製荷葉水鴨湯、蒸釀蓮藕夾、冰鎮鮮蓮子等時令荷香美饌。另一探城央綠廊夜市的熱鬧氛圍。

programme.title: 東坡家事#22粵PG
programme.desc: 小妹受傳染，狂性大發襲擊少游；病人欲逃出驛站，少游被他們抓傷。萬里帶官兵準備燒村……淑眉將藏有小妹名字的草娃交予梁氏；梁氏在街上遇高興和高貴，他們指小妹有孕，淑眉要母親加速害小妹流產。事件東窗事發……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#160粵

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#5粵普PG

programme.title: 我是小廚神-新加坡篇粵普
programme.desc: 12位候選小廚神分成3組進行初賽，爭奪8個入圍名額。今集主題是自選菜式，有人煮出媽媽的愛心，亦有人擺出精緻的法國主菜，其餘小朋友做出日本、印度、蒙古、斯里蘭卡、新加坡等各國的味道，評判之一的陳煒對這些異國風情有何評價？有參賽者滿有信心，卻未能守住廚師基本守則；亦有人不理會主持勸喻，不斷下醬油，能否換來驚喜味道？評判還有香港的烹調家麥潔兒及新加坡的糕點導師范鈺渟，要完全滿足三人的口味委實不易！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 血管鈣化是指血管內積聚異常物質，有機會導致血管硬化或收窄，增加患致命疾病風險。血管鈣化不可逆轉，心臟科醫生更提醒糖尿病、腎病，跟心臟病息息相關，建議及早預防。據估算，本港超過一成人口患有代謝綜合症，如同時出現中央肥胖、血壓偏高等幾項指標異常，便可能確診？內分泌及糖尿科醫生指此症有年輕化趨勢，久坐不動還會增加患病風險，建議可透過智能產品監測身體狀況。「睇餸食飯」，大廚許美德示範「碧綠川椒炒滷腩肉」。

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#3粵
programme.desc: 因嘉冰出現，萬里冷落了男友安多勳，她更刻意隱瞞，不讓嘉冰與多勳知悉彼此存在。多勳察覺異樣，懷疑萬里另有新歡，欲挽救感情，卻被嘉冰發現他形跡可疑……因某些原因，嘉冰識破萬里有戀情，並查證多勳的身分，擔心萬里會重蹈當年的覆轍再度受騙，欲有所行動……另一方面，萬里決意坦白，但嘉冰不在家；此時多勳到訪並提到新歡之事，萬里未及解釋，嘉冰便回來，她只好安排多勳暫時躲藏，欲向嘉冰說清楚，卻難以開口……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#8粵PG
programme.desc: 繼威、雪文受催情藥影響發生關係，幸如得償所願。家謙陪伴幸如散心，二人關係漸進。浩恩向幸如表白遭拒，熙妍陪伴他借酒澆愁。浩恩醉中誤將熙妍認作幸如並吻她；浩恩內疚，熙妍心情複雜，逃避面對此事。雪文、繼威秘密發展關係，雪文欲逼繼威與幸如分手，繼威藉口搪塞。幸如拜託家謙，引誘繼威投資將會股價暴跌的股票。幸如相約家謙吃飯作答謝，但家謙無奈要出席家族飯局，與未婚妻兼東馹集團千金胡曉彤見面。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 阿茲海默症是常見的長者腦退化疾病，屬認知障礙症之一，多數患者於65歲後發病。但本集案例患者62歲便確診，內科學者指長期服安眠藥、持續三高等都可能是成因。及早發現對治療至關重要，除了接受蒙特利爾認知測試外，透過正電子掃描檢測，還有助精準診斷阿茲海默症。本港大學現正研發「非入侵性腦神經調控治療」的新技術，詳情如何？加上近年面世的新藥，均有望延緩腦部衰退；而藉着日常習慣，也能夠減少患上認知障礙症的機會。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#13粵普
programme.desc: 菲菲粉絲靠貞貞幫助到總統套房樓層騷擾冰燕報仇，衝撞事件令冰燕事業停滯，冰燕控告酒店；面對態度強硬的冰燕，蜜語毫不退縮…翹琪煮不出理想菜餚，蜜語帶她回家鄉找鹹肉時巧遇紀封，意外之下蜜語紀封滯留島上同宿…

programme.desc: 屈奇頓有一地皮可安置非原居民，天生利用兆齊向學禮洽購，被學禮識穿。程凱找到能提升智能家居效能的新晶片，澤雨因成本及交貨期問題有所保留，兄弟反目。高哲得知思妤有意和別的男子交往，妒忌卻無能為力。定垚偶遇澤雨，二人感觸物是人非。是夜，定垚與高哲同為有緣無份而傷感，引起定垚對高哲往事的好奇。明晞與海泉就原居民賠償金額發生拗撬，海泉突然暈倒！啟堂突然回港，定垚發現他做過手術。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 血管鈣化是指血管內積聚異常物質，有機會導致血管硬化或收窄，增加患致命疾病風險。血管鈣化不可逆轉，心臟科醫生更提醒糖尿病、腎病，跟心臟病息息相關，建議及早預防。據估算，本港超過一成人口患有代謝綜合症，如同時出現中央肥胖、血壓偏高等幾項指標異常，便可能確診？內分泌及糖尿科醫生指此症有年輕化趨勢，久坐不動還會增加患病風險，建議可透過智能產品監測身體狀況。「睇餸食飯」，大廚許美德示範「碧綠川椒炒滷腩肉」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 一眾吃貨到華強北非買電子產品，而是吃「特大點心」！油條大得遮住林秀怡的臉？蝦餃、韭菜餃份量倍增，食得多還有現金券回贈！海景二字令人特別嚮往，深圳大鵬新區的民宿，無敵海景及特色泳池，盡是打卡位，換來沖繩度假感；返港去尖沙咀，望住海景食四人餐，撇除加一，千元有找，美食份量亦絕對夠飽肚。秀怡率眾到珠海做大「蠔」客，人民幣98元任食鮮蠔兩小時，附上燒蠔技巧。再到超市購入多款即食甜品，有甜品竟被嫌甜味不足？

programme.title: 東坡家事#23粵PG
programme.desc: 皇上欲讓琴操獻齋討好太后，東坡建議由閏之代煮；東坡不明閏之為何不讓琴操見太后，閏之稱琴操喜歡東坡。子才指賈大嬸和東坡父親蘇洵有私情，東坡從琴操送的蘇洵字畫中推算他還有四弟；東坡和閏之找賈大嬸查問……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#161粵
programme.desc: 溢收到舊女友玲寄來的喜帖，請他出席其子的滿月酒。溢為選購合玲心意的賀禮而大傷腦筋。溢選中名貴玩具熊，只好變買家中電腦籌錢，可是又被Sugar所破壞。溢說出只是想趁此機會，以圓他與玲合照的心願。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#6粵普PG
programme.desc: 黃蓉希望洪七公能收郭靖為徒，但洪七公拒絕，但黃蓉為了讓洪七公教授郭靖武功，於是做了很多美食給他，洪七公自然答應；楊康向完顏洪烈辭行，表示要回牛家村，完顏洪烈遊說他留下來，楊康之後向念慈表示要留下來…

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 林子祥是昔日粵語歌壇的中流砥柱，唱過的歌曲有一半是親自作曲。他能輕鬆駕馭任何類型的歌曲，唱出自己的風格，今次來節目「開騷」，獻唱<零時十分、<男兒當自強、<真的漢子等經典歌曲，並首度與秋官合唱。

programme.desc: 慶召開緊急會議，因高家獲政府封為模範家庭，特首要來家訪。慶組織了「接特委員會」，計劃多采多姿的節目，讓特首留下深刻印象。可是當根聽到內容後，力斥眾人的計劃毫無新意，更力薦自己擔任搞手，慶聽後意動答應。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#7粵普
programme.desc: 洪七公不辭而別後，歐陽克擄走黃蓉，郭靖通過記號找到並救下黃蓉。二人泛舟湖上，偶遇陸乘風並受邀到歸雲莊作客。黃蓉發現莊園為奇門遁甲的佈局，好奇下夜裡拉著郭靖出門，卻發現太湖集結了一眾以陸冠英為首的湖盜…

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 骨少肉嫩的彩虹鯛煮法多變，肥媽教煲「彩虹鯛越式酸湯」。「油炸鬼」煮餸相當好吃，一道「鬼馬龍鳳球」封住了六號嘴巴。菜價上升，學肥媽用水果炒菜，「青紅蘋果煙肉炒雞柳」只需25元。還有壓軸的「乳香肥牛卷」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 日式廚師發辦不需三百元人民幣？深圳親民套餐包海膽甜筒、和牛壽喜燒、鵝肝雪花配吞拿魚，CP值高！吃飽後要「滑」走脂肪，秀怡約同慧儀玩室內衝浪，惟兩位新手未玩已被澎湃衝浪聲嚇親，秀怡更遭拍檔水花攻擊？美女們為補充骨膠原轉赴珠海覓食，花膠撈飯、燜乾鮑和海參一次滿足美顏、吃貨願望。香港酒樓有抵食燒味推介，燒鵝、乳豬、白切雞統統只售一蚊？百年蛇羹老字號承傳家族秘方，同時以精緻蛇羹、糯米飯下午茶一新大家耳目！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 運動好處多，這次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」先做伸展練習，坐上瑜伽墊，試試逐步向下壓拉筋及轉體伸展。然後來一個「弓箭步壓腿」，保持十五秒；再將手放肩上「畫圓圈」，放鬆一下膊頭。運動除了讓身體動起來，還可改善一些不良姿勢，包括圓肩、寒背、高低膊等。伸出兩隻拇指放下巴，帶動頭移向上；舉起手臂，幻想是一道門並來回開合；雙手互扣，讓整個人向上伸展。常低頭玩手機的朋友不妨多加練習，對舒緩肩頸有幫助。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 經過一番心理掙扎，小源三人終於重新振作，再度與史納樂隊對峙。然而，儘管公主卯足全力，仍然無法填補雙方的實力差距，處於下風。正當她們感到一籌莫展，小奈的歌聲竟傳到來耳邊……

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 過去本港實行九年免費教育，固然有不少好處，不過有一批學生不喜歡讀書，但又要被迫上學，學校也很難處理。他們的成績很多由小學已經追不上，而且在學校經常鬧事，但是不讓他們上學，後果可能更加嚴重。新聞掏寶和大家重溫1995年專題。

滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#4粵
programme.desc: 唐芯喜愛的男團主音楊帆曾紅極一時，卻突然星途隕落，原與萬里有關。跨世代公關公司老闆高冠一欲入股某AI公司，要求萬里設法討好該公司的CEO，此人卻與萬里有過節。該公司將推出內置基圍蝦AI的智能手機，萬里需構思宣傳計劃，CEO要求萬里試用手機三天並完成AI訓練模型。萬里與唐芯、嘉冰嘗試合力「養大」基圍蝦AI，卻生變故……CEO再設法為難萬里，更非禮其下屬曾碧池。萬里忍無可忍，要求冠一終止合作計劃……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#9粵PG
programme.desc: 飯局上曉彤深得苓君歡心，家謙卻心不在焉。曉彤一直與弟弟胡哲朗競爭，她乘機自薦接手東馹新汽車項目，由家謙負責新廣告。曉彤看出家謙心事，提醒他於婚前做好抉擇。熙妍猜到幸如就是家謙的意中人，替家謙身不由己感可惜。幸如偶遇低血糖頭暈的曉彤，及時幫了她，彼此留下印象。繼威相約幸如為母親李佩貞慶生，雪文令幸如失約，並設法討好佩貞，但原來一切都在幸如計劃之內；她知道雪文憧憬組織家庭，遂故意向雪文透露佩貞喜好……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 油漆工人常接觸揮發性化學物，是患鼻咽癌主因嗎？化學病理學系教授指自小吃鹹魚「禍害」更深！鼻咽位於鼻腔深處，常於晚期才見病徵，而發病年齡較其他癌症普遍較低？鼻咽癌又名廣東瘤，原來99%港人體內有一種EB病毒，正是元兇。做檢測有陽性反應未必患癌，如何測試才會更精準？鼻咽癌較難用切除方式治療，做放射治療更有效，調查員秀怡外出向技師請教相關的「強度調控」新技術。另有中醫醫院教授細說治療癌症病人的主要方向。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#14粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語照顧發燒的紀封，最後順利把鹹肉帶回酒店；紀封想給蜜語補償，蜜語選擇做員工職業方向評估；中菜廳重開，翹琪發現鹹肉被掉包，幸好早有對策化解，令翱翔的計劃失敗；第二天中菜廳生意火爆，薛睿和蜜語協助調度。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 日式廚師發辦不需三百元人民幣？深圳親民套餐包海膽甜筒、和牛壽喜燒、鵝肝雪花配吞拿魚，CP值高！吃飽後要「滑」走脂肪，秀怡約同慧儀玩室內衝浪，惟兩位新手未玩已被澎湃衝浪聲嚇親，秀怡更遭拍檔水花攻擊？美女們為補充骨膠原轉赴珠海覓食，花膠撈飯、燜乾鮑和海參一次滿足美顏、吃貨願望。香港酒樓有抵食燒味推介，燒鵝、乳豬、白切雞統統只售一蚊？百年蛇羹老字號承傳家族秘方，同時以精緻蛇羹、糯米飯下午茶一新大家耳目！

programme.title: 東坡家事#24粵PG
programme.desc: 東坡和閏之懷疑皇上胎記，從太后入手調查。皇帝聽到民間歌謠指他篡位而大怒……賈大嬸請太后打聽身上有三星的孩子，太后聽後感疑惑。岐王準備宣布皇上非正統，安石出現解圍。嘉王和岐王始終不信，皇上指上天可證……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#162粵
programme.desc: 慶召開緊急會議，因高家獲政府封為模範家庭，特首要來家訪。慶組織了「接特委員會」，計劃多采多姿的節目，讓特首留下深刻印象。可是當根聽到內容後，力斥眾人的計劃毫無新意，更力薦自己擔任搞手，慶聽後意動答應。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#7粵普
programme.desc: 洪七公不辭而別後，歐陽克擄走黃蓉，郭靖通過記號找到並救下黃蓉。二人泛舟湖上，偶遇陸乘風並受邀到歸雲莊作客。黃蓉發現莊園為奇門遁甲的佈局，好奇下夜裡拉著郭靖出門，卻發現太湖集結了一眾以陸冠英為首的湖盜…

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 好拍檔江美儀、麥長青（麥包）暫別街市、屋邨地頭，一起來到Do姐主場遊樂一番！韓國一款表面雪白、平平無奇的粥品，售價竟跟鮑魚粥看齊，內有甚麼乾坤？日本一間居酒屋養了多頭猴子駐場，除了充當「侍應」之外，牠們還懂得表演娛賓？各地流傳不同祈福習俗，台灣屏東東隆宮亦有一種特別的轉運方法！根據過往經驗，旅遊熱點的貨幣均匯率較高，美儀、麥包可會遵循這個方向揀選「心水」地方？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 吳若希、譚嘉儀、鄭俊弘、林穎彤四位「星夢」歌手分成兩隊，接受Do姐出題考驗。胡慧冲帶大家參觀的泰國豪宅，並非給人居住，而是供燕子棲息，但要吸引燕子入屋築巢原來有竅妙。陸永一看貼士便想出答案，還暗諷Do姐見識少！兩隊接着享用大廚炮製的竹燕窩，並要答出這矜貴食材如何形成。鄺潔楹慕名到訪東京得獎食店，內裡食品美味，環境殘舊，究竟獲得甚麼獎項？兌換貨幣環節，兩隊面對四個陌生地方，是否選「島」有着數？

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 超級總動員S22
programme.desc: 全新場景、全新比賽陣容、全新遊戲並結合世界各國的場景與關卡。考驗麻吉好友和團體的合作默契，一場場歡笑、緊張與刺激的團體競賽，陪伴大朋友小朋友週末的歡聚時光。

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

Siguiendo las indicaciones de las pinturas y con la ayuda del libro de química de Chip, descubre que debe mezclar y fusionar varios elementos para crear unos zapatos de vidrio con los que pueda caminar sobre un suelo lleno de ácido, de modo que la puerta se levante y pueda seguir el camino. Cuando las antimaterias intentan seguirlo, mientras mezclan productos químicos, estos les aplastan la nariz.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La carga
programme.desc: Un transporte cargado de nitratos se dirige a la Torre Negra para que el Dr. No prepare explosivos. Chip se cuela en el transporte con la intención de ser llevado a su destino, pero al darse cuenta de la carga, hace todo lo posible para evitar que caiga en manos del malvado científico. Así, con la ayuda de átomos de bromo prisioneros, logra destruir el transporte y su peligrosa carga.

programme.desc: Rookie finds a large box full of building blocks. He starts building towers, but they keep collapsing whenever he looks away. programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Submarino
programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! programme.title: Good Luck Sam
programme.desc: Sam and Stéphane, childhood friends and ski equipment designers, embark on a wild quest to save their struggling business. They hatch a plan to enter Sam into the Winter Olympics, and have him compete under his father’s home country of Algeria.

programme.title: Open Door
programme.desc: Rudina embarks on a road trip with her pregnant sister Elma back to their Albanian hometown. However, Elma is unmarried, and they need to find someone to play the part of her husband in order not to anger their traditional father.

programme.title: Birth of a Champion
programme.desc: In 1984 Germany, a hot-headed teenage Boris Becker has but one goal: to play tennis in the big leagues, and to be the best at it. Despite his temper, he is scouted by coach Günther Bosch, who sees the future Wimbledon champion for what he is.

programme.title: Deep In The Wood
programme.desc: During the Krampus festival, little Tommi disappears mysteriously in the woods. He is found 5 years later in a building site on the outskirts of Naples, but his parents and the town locals are suspicious and frightened by his strange behaviour.

programme.title: Premiere Affaire
programme.desc: Nora, a young and an inexperienced criminal defense lawyer is charged with the case of a teenage boy accused of murdering a neighbour.

programme.title: Pure White
programme.desc: Vural, a husband and a father who was raised in faith, leads a seemingly pious and conformist life. Yet, everything takes a sudden dark turn when he learns a truth that will force him to confront his views on religion and morality.

programme.title: éarnMurders in B
programme.desc: At the foot of the majestic Béarn mountains, the wife of a notable, dressed as a medieval queen, is discovered drowned under the La Légende bridge in Sauveterre-de-Béarn. The exact spot where, in the 12th century, Queen Sancie was condemned to drowning for infanticide...

programme.title: Sima's Song
programme.desc: In 1970s Afghanistan, best friends Suraya and Sima are torn apart by political upheaval. Suraya is a wealthy communist and Sima is a traditional singer, and though their paths diverge, their enduring bond proves stronger than ideology.

programme.title: Coconut Hero
programme.desc: A teen living a dismal life in a small town with his single mum decides to end it all with a bullet to the head. In a cruel twist of fate, he survives to discover he has a fatal brain tumour. It is when he is really dying that life suddenly looks better.

programme.title: Adventures In The Land Of Asha
programme.desc: After 9-year-old Jules is banned from school because of his rare skin disease, his greatest wish is to be cured. He meets a mysterious new friend, Asha, after his dog runs away into the forest. Together, they go on an adventure to find a cure for him.

programme.desc: Inspector Bruhl is investigating the abduction of a young boy from a playground, until evidence suggests that the boy doesn’t exist at all. Is he a figment of the alleged mother’s fractured reality, or are answers buried in her traumatic past?

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs S01 - The Orphan
programme.desc: 66 million years ago, an orphaned baby Triceratops roamed the lush world of Laramidia, alone and vulnerable. Stalked by the fearsome Tyrannosaurus Rex, the youngster relied on her wits and diminutive size to survive. Today, paleontologists in Montana are uncovering her fossils, allowing us to imagine her life and the dangers she faced. Stunning VFX recreate her encounters, from escaping a giant pterosaur to a heart-stopping face-off with T-rex, bringing her story vividly to life.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S07 - U
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'u', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We go up, then underground, and meet an upbeat umbrella!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - A Case of the Lightnings
programme.desc: Messy and friends visit Fluff the Cloud's family, and things heat up in flash when her brother Nimby gets the lightnings.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Who Duggit?
programme.desc: A mystery is afoot! Somebody's been digging up and running off with Jackson's giant vegetables. Detectives Mojo and Bo must follow the clues to the cagey culprit.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch invents the world's most pungent perfume, he finds he needs one more ingredient: the super stinky aroma of the titan arum, a huge flower that blooms once every few years in the rainforests of Sumatra.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Blue Mountains
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets, exploring the land beyond the Blue Mountains where they outsmart the Cheeky Fox to find the softest ever beds.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Flatpack
programme.desc: While Mum and Dad struggle to build new flat-pack furniture, Bluey and Bingo transform the empty boxes into their own new world.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Hatzegopteryx Display
programme.desc: When Jen's drone goes missing on Dino Island, Andy heads out to track it down. He discovers one of the island's inhabitants, a giraffe-sized pterosaur, called Hatzegopteryx, is using the drone for a very special purpose.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Cup
programme.desc: Bella plays with her favourite cup - it makes the perfect drum for a sing along with Lift. Together, they visit Kingsley and Queenie who play the 'Tea Party Dash', but who will win?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Building Block Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels become architects so they can design, build and bring to life their very own clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Reunion Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Counting Badge

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Brandenburg Gate, Germany

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Statue of Liberty, USA
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch makes the Statue of Liberty fall right into the path of a passing ferry. It's up to the Go Jetters to save the day!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Chucklesome Trucks
programme.desc: When Rebecca works with the Troublesome Trucks, everyone expects the worst, but she defies everyone's expectations and has a very amusing day.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Paisley Sea
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck think they are headed to the zoo, but the bus takes a surprising diversion!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Duck's Quack

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I'm Not Even Scared of Nothing

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S02 - It's Time to Build a Scarecrow

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Fairy Tale

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Musical Statues

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stories

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Wisdom Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading Wonderful Stories about Wise Animals and want to learn about wisdom and how they can become more wise. They find out that wisdom isn't just about facts and figures, but that it's about good judgement and experiences too. They learn to plan ahead, concentrate on the task at hand, that sometimes big problems need a little help, to focus on the present and that good things come to those who wait. Thank goodness Duggee is so wise!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Listening Badge
programme.desc: After hearing a strange sound, the Squirrels turn to Duggee to help identify its source. They learn about sound waves, and that you can listen for different qualities in the sounds, such as if it's loud, quiet, high or low. Describing the sound can help you work out where it's coming from, so Duggee lets the Squirrels close their eyes as they listen to sounds and make their guesses.

The ball gets hit with a racket, flies through the sky, falls from a cliff and floats in the sea.

Meanwhile, the Go Jetters enjoy the peaceful nighttime views of the Avenue of the Baobabs in Madagascar - a stand of trees known as 'the upside down trees' because their branches look like roots, reaching up into the sky.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancée, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from “Nine Yang Scriptures” by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people by siding with the Qing and recruiting fighters from all backgrounds. Members of the Wudang and Emei sects are among the first to surrender and collude with local bullies. When they attack the Shaolin Monastery, its renowned disciples must unite to fight their enemies.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders

When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, &amp; colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: What Shark Attacked

programme.desc: Jim finds a Changeling when babysiting for Claire & finally has proof for Trollmarket but can't tell Claire; Meanwhile AAARRRGGHH!! moves in with Toby.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - D'aja Vu
programme.desc: Stuck in a time-loop, Aja finds unlikely help from Jim Lake and Team Trollhunters. Meanwhile, a giant Troll rampages the Arcadia High Science Fair, threatening to expose both the Troll world and Aja and Krel’s alien secret.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Flying the Coop
programme.desc: A menacing school board Administrator demands Aja and Krel's immigration papers to register for school - a task that turns dangerous for the two "illegal Aliens." Meanwhile, Aja bejins her warrior training with Vex

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Party Crashers
programme.desc: Aja attends her first teem party, Krel goes hunting for an urban legend with Eli, but the kids' fun is ruined when the Zeron Brotherhood crash their night. Meanwhile, Vex receives a message from Akiridion-5.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Witch Hunt
programme.desc: With the future at stake, Douxie and Claire cling to the hope that Arthur and Morgana can reconcile. Meanwhile, humans are hunting trolls in the woods.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Lady of the Lake
programme.desc: Merlin leads his ragtag crew on a quest to restore Excalibur and save Camelot. Elsewhere, Jim tries to convince Blinky that they're on the same side.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Inside Jokings It's A Jungle In There
programme.desc: Tip and Oh make their first inside joke and Oh shares it with everyone; Tip watches Oh's new alien plant while he's gone and breeds a catastrophe.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Dang You Saved My Life Boovsland Noir
programme.desc: Sharzod hates feeling indebted to Tip after being rescued and tries to get "even"; Police King Kyle must solve the case of Sharzod's missing mojo.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Deja Flu Crackridge Live
programme.desc: It's Archibald to the rescue when Loy, Sage and Finly come down with a bad case of the Déjà Flu. Archibald and Cousin Ashley take over the airwaves.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - House of the Future Dr. Buttersocks
programme.desc: Loy upgrades the house with a few seemingly helpful robotic enhancements. Archibald becomes a sock-puppet wrestling superstar.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia The Pet Monitor
programme.desc: Olivia and Francine both volunteer to be classroom pet monitor, so the teacher, Mrs. Hogenmuller, tells them each to explain why they deserve the job. Francine initially wins over the class with the help of her charming cat, Gwendolyn, but when it's revealed that Francine is afraid of the class lizard, everyone is happy for Olivia to take over the job - especially Francine!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plays Hotel
programme.desc: When school is let out early due to snow, Julian and Francine come over to Olivia's house. Olivia has the perfect game for them – Hotel! She transforms her house into a make-believe hotel. But then some strange things start to happen. Does the hotel have ghosts, or is Ian just playing tricks on them?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Keeps A Secret
programme.desc: Mother is busy planning a birthday party for Francine, and Olivia wants to help. The big surprise – TV star Kicky the Kangaroo -is due to make a special appearance. But when unexpected problems confront Kicky, Olivia has to step in and save Francine's party!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Gets Fit
programme.desc: In preparation for their class track and field day – dubbed the “Hogenmuller Games” after their teacher -Olivia uses a unique training regiment to help her best friend Julian be the fastest runner he can be and to give herself a jump on the competition in her own event.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - The Fairy Festival!
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Where’s The Party? The Noisiest Night
programme.desc: When Marcus loses an invitation to a birthday party and doesn’t know where it will take place, the Dew Drops set out to find the location and get Marcus to the party on time. When Harper can’t sleep because of a strange noise in her room, the Dews must figure out the source.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Escape The Backpack Play Date
programme.desc: While helping Lola pack for her first day of camp, the Dews get stuck inside her backpack! Using the random items inside, the Dews get crafty in their attempt to break out. When Eden and Phoebe join Harper and Marcus for a playdate, the Dews disagree on what activity their kids should do, ultimately learning that there are lots of ways to play!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Fluffy Flufferton
programme.desc: Feline popstar sensation Fluffy Flufferton is performing a concert at the Dollhouse Hotel, and Gabby unboxes tickets to see her! Gabby meets Fluffy and discovers that she’s afraid to try new things because she doesn’t want to make mistakes—why mess with perfection? But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our Cat of the Day segment, DJ Catnip sings a song about the Dollhouse Hotel.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cakey’s Cupcake Cousins
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a tin full of Cakey-like cupcake kitties, she realizes... Cakey's Cousins are coming to visit! Cakey welcomes his Cousins to the dollhouse and leads them through a fun-filled itinerary of activities, but quickly realizes his cousins have an agenda of their own. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - The First Lost Tooth
programme.desc: When Melman loses his first tooth, he fears he won't be Kate's baby anymore and goes on a city-wide chase to recover his tooth before Kate can replace him with a younger, cuter animal.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - The Lone Park Ranger
programme.desc: When Ranger Hoof invites Marty on a Junior Ranger night trot in Central Park, Marty is determined to prove he's got what it takes to do the job- but when Alex tags along for the ride, Marty learns that "what it takes" is a whole lot of teamwork.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Best Friends Day The White Whale
programme.desc: Pixie loves to ride the clouds, but she can't understand why Kelp doesn’t love it, too. If they don't agree on this, does that mean they're not best friends anymore? Kelp helps Ollie fulfill his dream of watching the white whale migration.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Shark and Pilot Fish Theo
programme.desc: When shark and pilot fish are separated it’s up to Kelp, Scallop, Cruz, and Waverly to help them find each other again. Scallop’s friend Theo finally comes clean on why he’s always rushing off.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - New Hat, New Tag! Furry Tail Ending
programme.desc: When Tag worries that she's no longer a "Go" dog, Lady Lydia helps her find a new persona by helping Tag try on a bunch of different hats. Luckily, when a runaway puppy needs to be wrangled, and only the speedy Tag can catch him, Tag realizes she was a Go dog all along. \ Sergeant Pooch reads Scooch, Tag and Kit a story book during their sleepover. But when the last pages are missing, the three kids work together to make up their own ending to the story.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Bigpaw, Big Problems Captain Scooch and Scally-Tag
programme.desc: Tag, Scooch and Kit think they found the perfect story for their newspaper: Bigpaw is in Pawston! But when they find out that Frank and Beans were lying to the town, they seek to uncover the truth and reveal it to everyone. \ When Sam Whippet sets up a pirate-themed race for the Race Cadets, pirate-loving Scooch takes on the role of captain. Tag struggles to take orders as first mate while helping Scooch navigate maritime obstacles and avoid the fearsome pirates.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Tanaka's Moving Castle Zenko Don't Go
programme.desc: Mr. Tanaka is moving places all by himself, so Team Zenko step in to assist, and learn the importance of asking people for help. When Sam's skateboard competition falls on the same day as her favourite creator Ken KaBlam's comic book signing, TZG secretly prevents him leaving town before she gets the chance to meet him.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Driven to Distraction To Bee or Not To Bee
programme.desc: When easily-distracted Luis is tasked with getting flowers for his grandmother's birthday party, TZG secretly keeps him on track. When Rodney's honey bees escape from their apiary (artificial beehive), TZG secretly brings them back.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he can't get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - A Cat-Tabulous Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas time in the dollhouse! After putting the final topper on the Christmas tree, Figgy the Elf calls and says that Santa Kitty needs help in his workshop, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go help her out. After some toy fixing and boxing fun, Gabby and Pandy get to meet Santa Kitty and his Kitty reindeer and join him delivering presents to all their friends in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd (who thinks it's the best kitty toy ever!) gets his paws on it!

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S2 - Fleshbeast Time Leafer
programme.desc: The Mighty Ones are terrorized by the human baby that runs amuck through the yard, but Rocksy is drawn to its power. Everyone thinks Leaf has gotten loopy, but his theories about time travel might just be what the Mighty Ones need to return to their home.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S2 - Clickety Clacks Rocksy's Thing
programme.desc: Rocksy’s “talent” goes to her head when she and Berry accidentally invent tap dancing. Rocksy finds one end of a shoelace and tasks her friends with helping her free it so she can have a thing of her very own.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - Small Change
programme.desc: When Puss feels powerless against the threat of the Bloodwolf, the crew asks Callista to help find the mysterious location of the Obelisk of Night

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - Little Lamb
programme.desc: When Puss and Dulcinea tracked down the Grotto of Riches, they each have their own plan on how to convince Mary and her flock to help find the Obelisk

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The New Governor
programme.desc: The girl’s plans to attend the Governor’s Ball are waylaid when they save a pregnant horse.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Risky Rescue
programme.desc: When a Tuckapaw boy is unfairly arrested, Lucky and her friends plan to break him out of jail.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The Rival Racer
programme.desc: A swift new recruit joins the school racing team, putting Lucky's dreams of riding out front in jeopardy. Pru and Abigail clash over a class project.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Palentine's Day
programme.desc: The PALs make plans for the Valentine's Day dance, then pivot to scare off a group of raiders who've come to rob the headmaster's vault.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Break in Case of Emergency

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Undercover
programme.desc: Jun forms an unlikely connection with Sledkin.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Webs' Masters
programme.desc: Eugene’s bond with Webmaster is put to the test when Webmaster leaves the group for a pack of Deathgrippers.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Mega Fat
programme.desc: After Mega Fat is fired from Baby Corp;he’s forced on the path of recovery towards being a Good Baby. However;Mega Fat is more interested in getting revenge on Boss Baby than finding the perfect family to adopt him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Abandoned Artifact of the Absentee Aliens
programme.desc: After George and Harold learn the truth about their mission, Dupe Licitous enlists the entire crew in a quest to repair a rogue satellite.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Hazardous Hysteria of the Hangry Hypnosinger
programme.desc: Everybody on the spaceship has been cryogenically frozen for three months — everyone, that is, except Krupp, who's wide awake and happily in charge.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Disturbing Dilemma of the Dysfunctional Doppelgangers
programme.desc: The crew meets their blue-hued doppelgängers when they crash-land on an alien planet where kids call all the shots.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Stryke Out
